notes.title: SMALL PATCH 5.0
notes.content:
Due to a request, I have added 'Gallery' into your dropdown list.

You can now view the beautiful Mommies from the puzzles you've completed, in a large file viewer!

Enjoy dears

-Natasha

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 4.0
notes.content:
Due to a suggestion in a review, I have implemented into the controls the ability to rotate pieces using your Right Mouse button, as well as the scroll wheel. You can now choose whichever is easiest for you.

I have also fixed the 'Completed Puzzles' section, and put in an 'Uncompleted Puzzles' tab as well, due to another suggestion.

Minor bug fixes. Menus look nicer, and the place-settings for pieces are transparent and larger.

Enjoy dears!

-Natasha

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Due to a very helpful review suggestion, I have implemented a small instruction text on your HUD, to make it easier to place pieces when first starting the game. 'Place pieces on center of black dots' 

Also, I have added random rotation of the puzzle pieces to the game as well. 

Thank you for playing, and I am committed to making my game as enjoyable as possible.

Thank you dears!
-Natasha

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Due to a helpful suggestion, I have added a completion HUD, so you can easily reload the puzzle, go to the level, or exit the game when you're finished!

Also, there is now a prompt for zooming out to see all the pieces!


Enjoy dears!

-Natasha
